title: White Buffalo Woman
melody_note: Transcribed by song2xml from Mettaben's recording of the Lakota White Buffalo Calf Pipe Song (no separation). Identification caution: the gathering songbooks also carry a different “White Buffalo Calf Woman (I seek your vision)” song (Rainbow Caravan #32, Am–G) — which of the two is the rank-35 circle staple is unverified.

fit.label: words match — sung Lakota text vs. printed text

verdict: Verdict: pending, with provenance care. This is a Lakota ceremonial song (sung in the third round of inipi to honor the original pipe); the page should stay documentation-only, with cultural attribution kept intact, unless guidance from Lakota practitioners says otherwise. Verify against the UK songbook's phonetic White Buffalo chant to settle which song rank 35 names.
